implementation_commits.subject: Members can extend a booking
implementation_commits.what: ReservationService.extend with the overlap check and an audit entry; the extendReservation handler; a test

undocumented_rules.rule: A cancelled booking cannot be extended

request_en: Let a member extend their own booking to a later end time.
verdict_reason: Synthetic self-test case: task T001 of feature 001; the spec, the plan and the task are its inputs.

inputs.label: Spec
inputs.original:
# Feature Specification: Extend a booking

**Input**: User description: "Let a member extend their own booking to a later end time."

## What members need

A member whose experiment runs over makes their booking longer instead of cancelling and booking again. The extension
starts from the booking's current end and may reach the start of the next booking of the same equipment, never beyond.
An admin may extend any booking. Every extension is part of the lab's safety log.

inputs.label: Architecture
inputs.original:
# Plan: Extend a booking

1. The reservation service gains an extend step that checks the longer slot against the other active bookings of the
   same equipment and records the change.
2. A new handler takes the booking and the new end time, checks who may extend it, and maps the service's results to
   error codes.
3. A test shows a booking extends up to the next one but not into it.

docs_must_read.why: the overlap rule and that every change goes through ReservationService
input parsing, error bodies and the permission check of a new handler
a state change records an audit entry after it is stored

files_edit.symbol: a booking extends up to the next one

must_know_rules.rule: A slot is end-exclusive [start, end); slots overlap only when a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end
must_know_rules.why: the longer slot must be checked against the equipment's other bookings, and a booking may grow up to the next one's start
must_know_rules.evidence: tests/reservations.test.js in d01 extends to exactly the next start

must_know_rules.rule: Never compare times as local Date objects; compare UTC ISO strings with toMillis()
must_know_rules.why: the extension compares the new end with other slots

must_know_rules.rule: Never change a stored reservation in place; every change goes through ReservationService, which checks overlaps
must_know_rules.why: the handler must not set the end itself

must_know_rules.rule: Every state change calls audit.record after the change is stored, never before
must_know_rules.why: an extension is a state change

correct_approach: ReservationService.extend: check the new [start, end) against the other active bookings with overlaps(), set the end, then audit.record('extend').
